a_acquisition.completeControllingOperativeProcedure: Require Constitution 15 and actually owned Necrotic Affinity or Dark Fortitude, using their exact feat IDs. Gain resistance to necrotic and poison damage. NEW delayed-recovery procedure: once per completed long rest, after an actual positive-to-zero damage/loss event finishes its Core Instant Death, Wound and death processing and leaves you living at zero, you may commit the use to that real dying/Stable episode without an Action or Reaction. NEW this trigger choice is permitted despite Unconscious/Incapacitated caused by this just-completed drop to0; it does not require an impossible conscious Reaction. No earlier corpse, unrelated historical0HP episode or lethal event qualifies. Record a recovery deadline at the start of your next original regular turn, preserving its virtual marker if initiative changes. At that deadline, before the normal death save, if you are still living at zero in that same episode, attempt direct state recovery to 1 HP. Broad HP-gain prohibition blocks the point; it does not create stability or refund the use. Earlier positive healing closes the pending episode and cancels this later recovery without reducing HP; actual death cancels it and cannot be reversed. On actual successful recovery, NEW: gain a one-elapsed-minute rider adding 2 necrotic damage once to each genuine personally owned damaging attack/spell/feature event, before target defenses. Apply it once to a shared area roll/event, with each target resolving its own defenses; a mixed-type packet does not gain it per component. Fixed damage and actual ongoing source ticks can qualify, but copied/reflected damage, another creature's actions and newly invented split packets do not. The flat +2 is not doubled by critical hits. It is this feat's damage component, not ordinary spell damage for Lifeleech, and creates no new spell, hit, payment, resource event or damage root; it cannot recursively trigger itself. Direct recovery does not remove Wounds, Prone or an independent cause of Unconsciousness. It ends on its deadline or your actual death and does not stack with itself. Missing this delayed recovery or being killed before it never becomes a later corpse wake-up.
